reasoning.metadata: For a held regular leaf: parent fstat, named lstat, held leaf fstat, final named lstat, final held leaf fstat, parent fstat = 6. Each absent directory uses four observations initially and four in final revalidation; 22*8 + 46*6 = 452 bounds all branches. Held directory paths use fewer. A count rejection precedes its disallowed syscall.
reasoning.descriptors: At most 22 parent directories remain held. At most one leaf is open because observe_leaf closes it in finally and requires closed before proceeding. Total registrations <=22+46=68; live cap <=22+1=23. Open and ledger append occur in the same protected section.
reasoning.close: close_attempted is set inside critical before os.close; closed is set only after success. Errors retain closed=false and are not retried. Final closure rejects any unresolved descriptor. Pending cancellation and deadline expiry cannot remain successful.
reasoning.deadline: One START/UNTIL=START+5 scope is shared by every count/open and final phase. Cleanup is followed by a deadline check; final exit also checks the same deadline after stdout flush. Receipt fields alone cannot substitute authoritative exit0.
reasoning.io: Regular leaves are opened O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK only for fstat and immediate close. No os.read, file read helper, hashing, SQLite, network, subprocess, or output-file write occurs. Final parent named/held identities remain bound.
